_readme: Edit this file each offseason instead of touching scripts/fetch-rosters.mjs.
provider: 'mfl' (default if omitted), 'espn', or 'sleeper' — which fetch logic/auth to use. Sleeper needs no auth at all.
id: the league ID for the current year (find it in the league's URL).

franchiseId: your team ID within that league (MFL: 4-digit franchise ID; ESPN: numeric team ID; Sleeper: numeric roster_id, found by matching your username against /v1/league/<id>/users + /v1/league/<id>/rosters).
name: fallback display name, used only if the live league/team name can't be fetched.
type: 'dynasty', 'bestball', or 'redraft' — controls which top-level sub-tab a league appears under.
format: dynasty leagues only — 'dynasty' (plain roster) or 'auction' (adds Salary/Yrs columns). Omit otherwise.
ESPN leagues additionally require ESPN_S2 and ESPN_SWID GitHub Actions secrets (browser cookies, not a login).
Array order is display order everywhere on the page (Rosters, Standings, Scoring).

lineupPilot: MFL only. When true, the sync also fetches this week's starters via TYPE=liveScoring and the Rosters card shows a checkbox lineup editor (login required to actually save) instead of the plain Active Roster table. Set on every MFL league that requires a submitted starting lineup.

tags: optional array of extra badge labels shown in the card's upper-right corner (e.g. 'Superflex') — anything not already derivable from type/format. Type (Dynasty/Best Ball/Redraft) and Salary Cap badges are added automatically, no need to repeat those here.
